records.title: IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection
records.reason: IVT-Guard is an AI-generated-content detection/reasoning model; it does not address LLM serving efficiency.

records.title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
records.reason: CompoWorld scales compositional environments for general-agent learning; the focus is environment/training scale, not LLM inference serving.

records.title: Do We Really Need KL Divergence for On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models?
records.reason: This paper studies KL-divergence choices in on-policy distillation of LLMs; it is a training objective study.

records.title: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
records.reason: PluginRSI evolves agent harnesses to accelerate subsequent harness optimization; the measured target is optimization/training search, not deployed inference.

records.title: CyberClear: A Benchmark for LLM Agent Systems on APT Attack Chain Provenance
records.reason: CyberClear benchmarks LLM agents on APT attack-chain provenance; it is an evaluation dataset and not an inference-efficiency contribution.
